contract_changes.reason: Real weak support changes the product capability policy from Unavailable to CopyingCollector; original stack, collector, shared-memory and runtime-policy checks remain.

The maintained module-entry source authority stays guarded by its contract and three structural code controls. This removes the dependency on the temporary task prose so the requested final task-folder deletion is possible.
